title: Word2Vec Embeddings for Categorical Values in Synthetic Tabular Generation
summary: Proposes embedding categorical columns with Word2Vec so that generators restricted to numerical data can handle mixed tables at all. CTGAN's own categorical encoding is the comparison the proposal is measured against, so the paper is a direct challenge to how mode-specific normalization treats discrete columns.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN models trained and compared against CTGAN's built-in categorical encoding

title: Synthesising artificial patient-level data for Open Science - an evaluation of five methods
summary: Asks whether patient-level data can be published for open science without compromising confidentiality, and evaluates five synthesis methods against that bar. CTGAN produces the structured tabular arm, an early appearance of the architecture in the open-science framing rather than the machine-learning one.
evidence: abstract: CT-GAN used to produce structured tabular synthetic patient data

title: Reaction Profile Forecasting by Artificial Data Generation for Wittig-Type Geminal Bromofluoroolefination
summary: Forecasts reaction profiles for a Wittig-type olefination, where the big-data approach that works for well-studied reactions is unavailable because few examples have been run. CTGAN is combined with a second augmentation technique to refine the model, putting SDV inside a synthetic-chemistry workflow published in a chemistry journal.
affiliations: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology
evidence: abstract: CTGAN combined with another augmentation technique to refine the model

title: A generative adversarial network enhanced ensemble learning-based prediction model for moment improvement effect of UHPC strengthened damaged RC beams
summary: Predicts the moment improvement gained by strengthening damaged reinforced concrete beams with ultra-high-performance concrete, from a corpus of 160 experimental cases. A tabular GAN expands that set before the ensemble is fitted, the same scarcity argument that recurs across every structural paper in this index.
evidence: abstract: 160 experimental cases expanded using a tabular GAN

title: Beyond Noise: Incorporating Pre-Trained Contractive Autoencoders for Enhanced GAN-based Tabular Data Creation
summary: Argues that the quality of the input noise, not only the architecture, limits how well a tabular GAN reproduces interactions between categorical and numerical columns. Transfer learning from a pre-trained contractive autoencoder replaces CTGAN's generator input, a modification to the model's entry point rather than its conditioning.
affiliations: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
evidence: abstract: transfer learning from a contractive autoencoder optimizes CTGAN's generator input noise

title: Synthetic Financial Data: A Case Study Regarding Polish Limited Liability Companies
summary: Tests whether synthetic company financials retain enough statistical structure to substitute for the real filings in downstream analysis. CTGAN and TVAE generate the substitute, so SDV's two deep synthesizers stand behind a national corporate dataset.
affiliations: Wroclaw University of Economics and Business
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and TVAE used to create the synthetic financial data

title: Recognition of Endotracheal Suctioning Activities: A Feature Extraction and Ensemble Learning Approach Based on Pose Estimation Data
summary: Recognises endotracheal suctioning from pose estimation, aimed at certifying home-healthcare practitioners in a procedure whose errors are consequential. Synthetic features generated by SDV feed the classification pipelines, an unusual case of the library operating on pose-derived features rather than clinical records.
affiliations: Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City
evidence: abstract: synthetic features generated by the SDV model feed the classification pipelines

title: Synthetic Dataset Generation for an Electricity Market Simulation Game
summary: Describes a multiplayer serious game used to teach short-term electricity market dynamics, which needs market data realistic enough to reason about but not tied to any real participant. The Gaussian Copula synthesizer supplies that data, so SDV underwrites a teaching tool rather than a research result.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula synthesizer supplies the game's data

title: Enhancing the diagnosis of CVD and depression comorbidity through the augmentation of synthetic metabolomics data
summary: Tackles cardiovascular and depression comorbidity, a diagnosis complicated by phenotypic heterogeneity and severe class imbalance in population health data. CTGAN-family augmentation is compared against random downsampling on UK Biobank records, with the argument that resampling destroys the multimodal structure SDV's normalization is built to preserve.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN-family augmentation compared against random downsampling on UK Biobank data

title: Benchmarking Statistical and Deep Generative Models for Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Student Data in Educational Data Mining
summary: Argues that educational data mining is held back by scarcity, privacy restriction and the difficulty of collaborating across institutions, and benchmarks generators against those constraints. All four models benchmarked are SDV's, Gaussian Copula, CopulaGAN, CTGAN and TVAE, so the study measures the library's internal spread rather than SDV against alternatives.
evidence: abstract: benchmarks Gaussian Copula, CopulaGAN, CTGAN and TVAE on student records

title: Synthetic Data Augmentation for Imbalanced Tabular Protein Subcellular Localization
summary: Compares augmentation methods for protein subcellular localization, where the minority classes are the functionally important ones and systematic comparison is missing. CTGAN and TVAE are set against SMOTE and TabDDPM, placing SDV's synthesizers between a classical oversampler and a diffusion model on the same task.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and TVAE among four methods benchmarked

title: Non-Invasive Blood Glucose Estimation from Exhaled Breath: Patient-Level Validation of a Compact Electronic Nose Approach
summary: Estimates blood glucose from exhaled breath as an alternative to repeated capillary sampling, with the evaluation complicated by a small patient cohort. Notable for methodological care: the Gaussian copula is fitted on training subjects only and applied fold-wise, so augmentation cannot leak across the validation split, which is the failure mode most augmentation papers in this index do not address.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian copula fitted on training subjects only, for fold-wise augmentation

title: Analysis of Microbiome for AP and CRC Discrimination
summary: Explores whether microbiome profiles can distinguish adenomatous polyps from colorectal cancer, limited by how few sequenced cohorts exist. It names the Synthetic Data Vault Python library explicitly and uses the Gaussian Copula synthesizer, one of the clearer cases in this batch where the library rather than a bare architecture is cited.
evidence: abstract: names the Synthetic Data Vault Python library with a Gaussian Copula synthesiser

title: Comparative analysis of TGAN and other GAN models for synthetic earthquake data: a case study with data from Türkiye
summary: Compares GAN architectures for generating synthetic seismic records from Turkish catalogue data. The title names TGAN as one of the compared models; no abstract is indexed, so the role is read from the title alone.
evidence: title names TGAN in a comparison of GAN models; no abstract indexed
needs: fetch the full text and confirm which TGAN implementation is compared

title: Real-Time Data Generation and Anomaly Detection for Security User Profiles
summary: Builds security user profiles from live data streams and detects anomalies against them, where working from real user traces raises the privacy problem the system is meant to serve. The generation engine is powered by the Synthetic Data Vault library, making SDV a runtime component of an operational pipeline rather than an offline step.
venue: International Symposium on Networks, Computers and Communications
evidence: abstract: data generation engine powered by the Synthetic Data Vault Python library

title: Evaluation of Generative AI Models for Processing Single-Cell RNA-Sequencing Data in Human Pancreatic Tissue
summary: Evaluates generative models on single-cell RNA sequencing, where rare cell types are exactly the ones an analysis wants to characterise and exactly the ones with fewest observations. Gaussian Copula is among the generators producing synthetic cells for the underrepresented types, an application of SDV to genomics rather than tabular records.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula among generators of synthetic cells for underrepresented types

title: Comparison of Three Anonymization Tools for a Health Fitness Study
summary: A case study anonymising cardio-respiratory fitness and commuting data for Slovenian schoolchildren so it can be shared openly. SDV is evaluated head to head against ARX and SynDiffix, which places the library among disclosure-control tools rather than among generative models, a comparison set it rarely appears in.
affiliations: Berlin Institute of Health at Charité
evidence: abstract: evaluates ARX, SDV and SynDiffix on health fitness study data

title: Validated Synthetic Data Generation from a Multicenter Spine Surgery Registry
summary: Releases synthetic data from a multicentre spine surgery registry, where institutional governance rather than technical difficulty is what blocks sharing. A GaussianCopula model is trained on 52 structured variables, so SDV is the mechanism by which a governed clinical registry becomes distributable.
evidence: abstract: GaussianCopula model trained on 52 structured variables from a surgical registry

title: Research on Rust Damage Diagnosis Method for Street Light Poles Based on WAESN and CT-IAOA-LightGBM
summary: Diagnoses rust damage in street light poles using a wireless acoustic emission sensor network, motivated by the collapse risk to traffic below. A CTGAN signal is present in the record but the indexed abstract describes only the sensor system, so the generator's role is unverified.
evidence: CTGAN signal in the record; the indexed abstract describes only the sensor system
needs: fetch the full text and establish whether CTGAN is used or only cited

title: Predictive models for the axial capacity of NSM- and hybrid FRP-strengthened RC columns
summary: Builds predictive models for the axial capacity of FRP-strengthened concrete columns, where design codes leave the effectiveness of fibres under compression uncertain. 112 experimental samples are paired one-for-one with 112 TGAN-generated ones, an unusually explicit statement of how far the synthetic half of a training set extends.
affiliations: Iran University of Science and Technology
evidence: abstract: 112 experimental samples paired with 112 TGAN-generated samples

title: Synthesizing Microbiome-Disease Association Data using GANs
summary: Evaluates four GAN models on synthesizing microbiome-disease associations drawn from the Human Microbe Disease Association Database. CTGAN and CopulaGAN are two of the four, so half the comparison is SDV's.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and Copula GAN applied to microbiome-disease association data

title: A Range-based Association Rule and GAN-based Hybrid Approach for Imbalanced Classification
summary: Combines range-based association rule sampling with a modified tabular GAN to handle imbalanced classification in automation settings. The modification to the generator makes this a derivative rather than a use, though the abstract does not state which parts were changed.
evidence: abstract: combines association-rule sampling with a modified tabular GAN

title: C3-TGAN: Controllable Tabular Data Synthesis with Explicit Correlations and Property Constraints
summary: The unversioned TechRxiv record for C3-TGAN, whose abstract is identical to the v1 record already curated in shard 09. Retained with duplicate_of set so a later sweep resolves both DOIs to one entry rather than indexing the preprint twice.
evidence: abstract identical to the v1 TechRxiv record; same work

title: Fs-TGAN: An Enhanced Approach for IoT Intrusion Detection Based on Feature Selection and Tabular GAN
summary: Proposes an IoT intrusion detection approach pairing feature selection with a tabular GAN. The name Fs-TGAN indicates a TGAN variant, but no abstract is indexed, so whether the generator is modified or merely applied is unestablished.
evidence: title names Fs-TGAN, an apparent TGAN variant; no abstract indexed
needs: fetch the full text and establish whether the generator is modified or applied unchanged

title: A data augmentation method for multiaxial fatigue life prediction based on physics-informed tabular generative adversarial network
summary: Predicts multiaxial fatigue life, a task where each training sample is a specimen tested to failure and datasets stay small by construction. CTGAN is constrained by a physical equation during generation, so synthetic samples must satisfy the governing relation rather than only match the observed distribution, which is a distinctly engineering answer to the fidelity problem.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN constrained by a physical equation during generation

title: A synthetic data generation pipeline to reproducibly mirror high-resolution multi-variable peptidomics and real-patient clinical data
summary: Argues that clinical and molecular datasets are costly enough that they ought to be shared, and that privacy risk is what prevents it. The pipeline is built on Gaussian copulas chosen specifically to preserve associations across high-resolution peptidomics variables, so SDV's copula is selected for a dependence-preservation property rather than convenience.
evidence: abstract: algorithm based on Gaussian copulas preserves associations in peptidomics data

title: Data Anonymization for Open Science: A Case Study
summary: The preprint of the ARX, SDV and SynDiffix comparison later published in Scientific Data, on the same Slovenian schoolchildren fitness dataset. Recorded separately with duplicate_of set to the journal version.
affiliations: Berlin Institute of Health at Charité
evidence: abstract: evaluates ARX, SDV and SynDiffix as anonymization tools; preprint of the Scientific Data paper

title: Evaluation of Synthetic Data Generation Models for Balancing Multiclass Metabolomic Profiles
summary: Balances a highly imbalanced multiclass metabolomic dataset for metabolic syndrome analysis, where the classes of clinical interest are the sparse ones. Gaussian Copula, FAST ML, CTGAN and TVAE are the evaluated models, making the comparison almost entirely internal to SDV.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula, FAST ML, CTGAN and TVAE among models evaluated

title: CTGAN-Bandit: A Conditional Tabular GAN Model Leveraging Upper Confidence Bound Estimators for Hardware Design Verification
summary: Targets constrained random verification in ASIC design flow, where parametrised tests are simulated repeatedly to reach untried execution paths. CTGAN is conditioned by an Upper Confidence Bound acquisition function so generation is steered toward unexplored coverage, another instance of SDV generating a search rather than a dataset, this time from a memory manufacturer.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN conditioned by an Upper Confidence Bound acquisition function

title: On Predicting Marine Engine Measurements with Synthetic Data in Scarce Dataset
summary: Predicts marine engine measurements where instrumenting a vessel at scale is impractical and the recorded dataset stays small. CopulaGAN produces the synthetic datasets, from the same group whose steam turbine exergy work appears in batch A, so this is a second marine-engineering application of SDV by the same authors.
venue: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
evidence: abstract: CopulaGAN employed to produce the synthetic datasets

title: Generative Data Modelling for Diverse Populations in Africa: Insights from South Africa
summary: Addresses how thin the demographic and health record is for African populations, and asks whether generative modelling can fill it without misrepresenting the groups involved. CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE are examined with SDMetrics for scoring, so SDV supplies both the generation and the fidelity check in a setting where getting the distribution wrong has representational consequences.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE examined; SDMetrics referenced

title: Generating Realistic Benchmarks for Dynamic Truck and Trailer Scheduling using Gaussian Copulas
summary: Argues that dynamic optimisation research needs benchmark generators producing controlled, reproducible changing environments, and that real logistics data is too scarce to build them from. A Gaussian Copula generation model drives the benchmark construction, so SDV manufactures the problem instances an algorithm competition runs on.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula-based generation model drives the benchmark construction

title: Comparative Analysis of the Efficiency of Synthetic Data Generation Methods in Classification and Regression Problems
summary: Compares CTGAN and TVAE across both classification and regression tasks, noting that most published comparisons cover only the former. Both methods under test are SDV's, so the contribution is an account of how the library's two deep synthesizers behave when the target is continuous.
evidence: abstract: comparative analysis of CTGAN and TVAE on regression and classification tasks

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Non-Invasive Hepatitis C Virus Detection Using Feature Selection
summary: Builds non-invasive multiclass hepatitis C classification from standard laboratory panels, aimed at low-resource settings where the conventional diagnostic path is invasive and expensive. SDV-based oversampling balances the dataset before feature selection, so the library sits at the head of a pipeline intended for deployment rather than publication.
affiliations: Rajshahi University of Engineering and Technology
evidence: abstract: SDV-based oversampling balances the dataset before feature selection

title: Synthetic data for pharmacogenetics: enabling scalable and secure research
summary: Evaluates seven generation methods on pharmacogenetic profiles, spanning classical synthpop, the avatar method, copulas and a language-model approach. Three of the seven are SDV's, copulagan, ctgan and tvae, and the same group's earlier correlation-structure study appears in batch B, making this one of the more systematic external assessments of the library.
evidence: abstract: copulagan, ctgan and tvae among seven generation methods evaluated
